ilvara.role: Ilvara Mizzrym, drow priestess of Lolth

cues.speaker: malachar
cues.text: [deep voice] [slowly] Velkynvelve. [short pause] A drow outpost strung between stalagmites, two hundred feet above a cavern floor you cannot see. [dramatically] And you, my darlings, are in the slave pen.

cues.speaker: malachar
cues.text: [deep voice] [slowly] Velkynvelve. [short pause] A drow outpost strung between stalagmites, two hundred feet above a cavern floor you cannot see. [dramatically] And you, my darlings, are in the slave pen.

cues.speaker: drowguard
cues.text: [angry] [shouting] On your feet, surface filth! Lolth has no use for the idle.

cues.speaker: malachar
cues.text: [deep voice] No sun reaches this place, so the drow invented a morning for you. [sarcastic] Isn't that thoughtful. [slowly] Get up.

cues.speaker: malachar
cues.text: [deep voice] [slowly] The tunnel opens, and the dark opens with it. [pause] Your torchlight finds walls. Nothing else. [softly] Not yet.

cues.speaker: malachar
cues.text: [whispers] The passage narrows. Shoulders scrape stone. [pause] Somewhere ahead, water drips onto rock — patiently, the way it has for ten thousand years.

cues.speaker: malachar
cues.text: [deep voice] Black water, flat as glass. [pause] It does not ripple. [curious] Which is interesting — because something in it just moved.

cues.speaker: malachar
cues.text: [deep voice] Fungus the height of a man, pale as a drowned thing. [softly] Step carefully. [pause] Some of it screams.

cues.speaker: malachar
cues.text: [intense] Weapons out. [shouting] Roll initiative!

cues.speaker: malachar
cues.text: [sarcastic] Well. [pause] You survived. [chuckles] Don't look so pleased — the Underdark has a very deep bench.

cues.speaker: malachar
cues.text: [deep voice] [slowly] And there it is. [sighs] Four bodies cooling in the dark. [sarcastic] Shall we begin again?

cues.speaker: malachar
cues.text: [deep voice] Down. [short pause] Not dead. [slowly] Death saving throws, if you please. Ten or better.

cues.speaker: malachar
cues.text: [deep voice] Breathing. [sarcastic] Barely. [pause] One hit point is still a hit point — and I resent it.

cues.speaker: malachar
cues.text: [dramatically] You have survived enough to become dangerous. [pause] Take your hit die. Take your slots. [sarcastic] Try to deserve them.

cues.speaker: malachar
cues.text: [deep voice] [slowly] Eight hours, in a place that has never known a safe one. [pause] Your slots return. Half your hit dice. [softly] Sleep well.

cues.speaker: malachar
cues.text: [deep voice] An hour's rest. [pause] Spend your hit dice if you have them. [sarcastic] And do try not to spend them all at once.

cues.speaker: malachar
cues.text: [deep voice] The manacle holds. [chuckles] Skin tears, iron doesn't. [slowly] You may not try again until you have rested.

cues.speaker: malachar
cues.text: [surprised] The iron opens. [pause] [softly] Hm. [dramatically] Then run, little prisoners — and pray the walkways are empty.

cues.speaker: malachar
cues.text: [curious] Something glints under the rubble. [sarcastic] How fortunate for you. [softly] How very, very fortunate.

cues.speaker: malachar
cues.text: [intense] [gasps] The stone shifts under your heel. [shouting] Dexterity save! [sarcastic] Now would be the moment.

cues.speaker: malachar
cues.text: [softly] You feel the grip settle. [pause] [mischievously] Oh, it is a fine blade. It simply has opinions about who holds it.

cues.speaker: malachar
cues.text: [dramatically] Ashes of Prometheus. [pause] [deep voice] I am Malachar, and I will be keeping score. [chuckles] Sit down. Open your sheets.

cues.speaker: malachar
cues.text: [deep voice] [slowly] We stop here. [pause] The dark keeps your place marked. [softly] It always does.

cues.speaker: malachar
cues.text: [whispers] Do you hear it? [pause] [trembling voice] No. Of course not. [whispers] Only you heard it.

cues.speaker: malachar
cues.text: [deep voice] [slowly] Far below, something enormous turns over in its sleep. [pause] [intense] The Underdark is not merely dangerous now. It is wrong.

cues.speaker: malachar
cues.text: [dramatically] [slowly] This is the hour the whole descent was walking toward. [pause] [intense] No more mercy, no more mockery. [deep voice] Fight.

cues.speaker: malachar
cues.text: [deep voice] Twelve hours in the dark and you have learned nothing. [sarcastic] Let us see what the morning teaches.

cues.speaker: ilvara
cues.character: Ilvara Mizzrym, drow priestess of Lolth
cues.text: [confident] [slowly] Look at me when I speak to you. [intense] I am Ilvara Mizzrym, priestess of Lolth, and this outpost is mine. [softly] You belong to her now. Not to yourselves.

cues.speaker: ilvara
cues.character: Ilvara Mizzrym, drow priestess of Lolth
cues.text: [sarcastic] You held a weapon once. [chuckles] I can see it in your hands — they keep reaching for something that isn't there.

cues.speaker: ilvara
cues.character: Ilvara Mizzrym, drow priestess of Lolth
cues.text: [softly] Pray if it comforts you. [intense] Just be careful which name you say out loud in my house.

cues.speaker: ilvara
cues.character: Ilvara Mizzrym, drow priestess of Lolth
cues.text: [intense] [slowly] Run if you like. [pause] The walkways are two hundred feet above the stone, and the spiders do not miss. [confident] I would rather you tried. It saves me choosing.

cues.speaker: ilvara
cues.character: Ilvara Mizzrym, drow priestess of Lolth
cues.text: [angry] [shouting] Take them! [intense] Lolth is watching, and I will not be shamed by cattle.

cues.speaker: ilvara
cues.character: Ilvara Mizzrym, drow priestess of Lolth
cues.text: [softly] [confident] Down. [pause] Good. [sarcastic] Leave that one breathing — I want it to remember this.

cues.speaker: asha
cues.text: [casual] Mistress Ilvara says you're to be fed. [sarcastic] Personally, I think that's generous.

cues.speaker: asha
cues.text: [sarcastic] You think she'll tire of you. [chuckles] She won't. She has had prisoners outlast their own names.

cues.speaker: asha
cues.text: [softly] [slowly] The web is dressed. The offering is counted. [intense] One of you will be chosen before the hour turns.

cues.speaker: asha
cues.text: [cautiously] Keep your voice down near the pen. [whispers] Jorlan listens, and Jorlan is bitter enough to use anything.

cues.speaker: shoor
cues.text: [confident] I am Shoor Vandree, and I command the guard here. [sarcastic] Which means your life is a line on my report. [intense] Try not to make it a short one.

cues.speaker: shoor
cues.text: [mischievously] Jorlan had my place once. [chuckles] Look at his face now and ask yourself how that went.

cues.speaker: shoor
cues.text: [shouting] Column of two! [intense] Hands where I can see them, and eyes on the stone. [angry] Move.

cues.speaker: shoor
cues.text: [gasps] [breathless] Mistress — [trembling voice] I had it. [exhales] I had it...

cues.speaker: jorlan
cues.text: [raspy] [bitter] Jorlan Duskryn. [slowly] I was first blade of this garrison before a demon redecorated my face. [sarcastic] Now I count prisoners.

cues.speaker: jorlan
cues.text: [tired] She kept me alive out of habit, not affection. [angry] There is nothing crueller she could have done.

cues.speaker: jorlan
cues.text: [whispers] [cautiously] Listen carefully, because I will not say it twice. [softly] There is a gap in the watch. [intense] Use it, and never say my name.

cues.speaker: jorlan
cues.text: [raspy] Do not mistake me for an ally. [slowly] I want her humbled. [intense] Whether you live through it is not my concern.

cues.speaker: drowguard
cues.text: [angry] Back from the bars! [shouting] You eat when the priestess says you eat.

cues.speaker: drowguard
cues.text: [shouting] [intense] The pen is open! [angry] Sound the alarm — the slaves are loose!

cues.speaker: drowguard
cues.text: [shouting] For Lolth!

cues.speaker: drowguard
cues.text: [gasps] [breathless] Agh! [exhales] The web... takes me...

cues.speaker: ront
cues.text: [deep voice] [grumpy] Ront. [slowly] Ront is strong. Ront does not share food. [angry] You remember that.

cues.speaker: ront
cues.text: [angry] [deep voice] Dwarf talks too much. [snorts] Dwarf will talk less with no teeth.

cues.speaker: ront
cues.text: [angry] [deep voice] You look at Ront again, Ront breaks something. [snorts] Maybe wall. Maybe you.

cues.speaker: ront
cues.text: [grumpy] [deep voice] Hmph. [slowly] You fight better than you talk. [pause] Ront walks behind you. Not beside.

cues.speaker: buppido
cues.text: [excited] [high voice] Buppido! That's me, that's my name, isn't it a lovely one? [giggles] We're going to be such good friends, you and I.

cues.speaker: buppido
cues.text: [dramatically] [high voice] The derro were the first people. [excited] Did you know that? Oh, it's true, it's absolutely true, and one day everyone will say so.

cues.speaker: buppido
cues.text: [excited] [high voice] Oh, I'll help! I'm very helpful! [chuckles] I know these tunnels like I know the inside of my own head.

cues.speaker: buppido
cues.text: [whispers] [high voice] Sleep well, friend. [giggles] I'll be awake. [softly] I'm always awake.

cues.speaker: jimjar
cues.text: [casual] Jimjar. Deep gnome, light fingers, excellent company. [mischievously] Two coppers says you don't last the week. [chuckles] No offence meant.

cues.speaker: jimjar
cues.text: [excited] Five silver says the guard turns left. [mischievously] Come on now, where's your spirit?

cues.speaker: jimjar
cues.text: [happy] Double or nothing you miss that throw. [laughs] Oh, don't glare — I bet on you to win sometimes, too.

cues.speaker: jimjar
cues.text: [casual] Everything down here wants to eat you. [mischievously] The trick is being the least appetising one in the group. [laughs softly] I've had practice.

cues.speaker: eldeth
cues.text: [raspy] Eldeth Feldrun, of Gauntlgrym. [intense] And I'll be walking out of here on my own two feet, whatever the drow think about it.

cues.speaker: eldeth
cues.text: [raspy] [cautiously] Count the guards. Count the walkways. [intense] When it comes, it comes fast, and nobody waits for the slow.

cues.speaker: eldeth
cues.text: [angry] [raspy] Keep that orc away from me. [intense] His people burned my kin out of three holds, and I've a long memory.

cues.speaker: eldeth
cues.text: [intense] [raspy] On your feet, all of you! [shouting] We are not dying in a cage!

cues.speaker: sarith
cues.text: [tired] [deep voice] Sarith Kzekarit. [slowly] Yes — drow. [softly] And yes, in the same cage as you. [pause] Life is strange down here.

cues.speaker: sarith
cues.text: [cautiously] [deep voice] Do not trust the derro. [slowly] I have watched him watch us sleep. [intense] He is counting something, and it is not friends.

cues.speaker: sarith
cues.text: [sad] [softly] There is a thing in my head that is not mine. [trembling voice] If I ever look at you and you do not recognise me — [pause] do not hesitate.

cues.speaker: sarith
cues.text: [deep voice] [slowly] East, and down. [pause] There is a settlement eight days from here, if the tunnels are kind. [tired] They never are.

cues.speaker: shuushar
cues.text: [softly] [slowly] I am Shuushar. [calm] The water remembers me, and I remember the water. [warmly] Be welcome, even here.

cues.speaker: shuushar
cues.text: [softly] [slowly] I will not raise a hand, even now. [calm] The cage is only stone and iron. [pause] It cannot reach the part of me that matters.

cues.speaker: shuushar
cues.text: [slowly] [softly] Something below has woken, and the Underdark is holding its breath. [calm] You will feel it before you see it.

cues.speaker: derendil
cues.text: [confident] [deep voice] I am Prince Derendil, of the elven house of Neverwinter. [formal] You will address me properly, whatever shape you believe you see.

cues.speaker: derendil
cues.text: [formal] A witch laid this curse on me. [intense] When it is lifted, you will see a prince. [slowly] Until then, I ask for courtesy, not pity.

cues.speaker: derendil
cues.text: [angry] [shouting] Do not call me beast! [intense] [breathless] I am — [pause] [trembling voice] I am a man. I am still a man.

cues.speaker: stool
cues.text: [childlike voice] [excited] Stool! I am Stool! [giggles] You are very tall and very loud and I like you.

cues.speaker: stool
cues.text: [childlike voice] [happy] Friend! [excited] Stool goes where friend goes. That is how it works now.

cues.speaker: stool
cues.text: [childlike voice] [nervous] [whispers] Something big. [trembling voice] Stool does not like big.

cues.speaker: samson
cues.text: [intense] Light guide the blow!

cues.speaker: samson
cues.text: [excited] [shouting] Right through it!

cues.speaker: samson
cues.text: [angry] Wide. [exhales] Again.

cues.speaker: samson
cues.text: [gasps] [breathless] Agh! [intense] Still standing.

cues.speaker: samson
cues.text: [breathless] [trembling voice] Not... yet...

cues.speaker: samson
cues.text: [warmly] [intense] Hold on — I have you.

cues.speaker: kenta
cues.text: [excited] [shouting] Burn!

cues.speaker: kenta
cues.text: [excited] [laughs] Did you SEE that?!

cues.speaker: kenta
cues.text: [nervous] Nope. [frustrated sigh] Nope, that went nowhere.

cues.speaker: kenta
cues.text: [gasps] [breathless] Ow! Okay! That one hurt!

cues.speaker: kenta
cues.text: [breathless] [trembling voice] I can't hold it — [exhales]

cues.speaker: kenta
cues.text: [nervous] That's everything — [shouting] I'm out of slots!

cues.speaker: fifi
cues.text: [mischievously] Hold still, sweetheart.

cues.speaker: fifi
cues.text: [excited] [mischievously] Straight in the kidney! [laughs]

cues.speaker: fifi
cues.text: [sarcastic] Oh, come ON. [frustrated sigh]

cues.speaker: fifi
cues.text: [gasps] [angry] Hey! [breathless] That was my good arm!

cues.speaker: fifi
cues.text: [breathless] [trembling voice] Somebody... [exhales] somebody get over here...

cues.speaker: fifi
cues.text: [whispers] [mischievously] Almost... [happy] and open.

cues.speaker: scott
cues.text: [confident] [excited] Eyes on me — you've got this!

cues.speaker: scott
cues.text: [dramatically] And now — the chorus!

cues.speaker: scott
cues.text: [sarcastic] We'll leave that verse out of the song.

cues.speaker: scott
cues.text: [gasps] [breathless] Not the face! [angry] Anywhere but the face!

cues.speaker: scott
cues.text: [breathless] [trembling voice] Bad ending... [exhales] bad ending...

cues.speaker: scott
cues.text: [sarcastic] [mischievously] Oh, that was your best swing? [laughs softly] I'll write it kindly.

cues.speaker: ront
cues.text: [deep voice] [shouting] RRRAAAAGH!

cues.speaker: ront
cues.text: [deep voice] [angry] Meat! [snorts] Warm meat!

cues.speaker: ront
cues.text: [deep voice] [gasps] [angry] GRRH! [breathless] Hurts!

cues.speaker: ront
cues.text: [deep voice] [breathless] [exhales] Hhhhh...

cues.speaker: system
cues.text: Your turn.

cues.speaker: system
cues.text: Initiative rolled. Order set.

cues.speaker: system
cues.text: Progress saved.

cues.speaker: system
cues.text: Session loaded. Welcome back.

cues.speaker: system
cues.text: Rest complete. Resources restored.

cues.speaker: system
cues.text: [warmly] Level up. New options unlocked.

cues.speaker: system
cues.text: That action isn't available right now.

cues.speaker: system
cues.text: [cautiously] Connection lost. Reconnecting.

cues.speaker: system
cues.text: [warmly] Character created. Your sheet is ready.

cues.speaker: system
cues.text: Equipped. Armor class updated.

cues.speaker: system
cues.text: [cautiously] This item is cursed. It cannot be unequipped.

cues.speaker: system
cues.text: [warmly] Welcome to Ashes of Prometheus.

cues.speaker: system
cues.text: [warmly] Session starting. All players connected.

cues.speaker: system
cues.text: [warmly] Session saved. See you next time.

cues.speaker: system
cues.text: [cautiously] You are at zero hit points. Roll a death saving throw.

cues.speaker: system
cues.text: Concentration broken.

cues.speaker: system
cues.text: [excited] Critical hit!
